verdict.rationale: Stripe's ACS/ACP stack clearly enables in-chat checkout — chat-native browsing, recommendations, and 'complete purchases without leaving the conversation' via SPTs and per-agent onboarding — with OpenAI/ChatGPT explicitly confirmed as the first live implementer. However, evidence only names ChatGPT as an actual integrated surface; there's no documentation or report of Claude, Gemini, or Copilot support, and the whole embedded-agent (OCA) flow plus the custom ACP checkout are explicitly gated as private preview and US/Canada/EU-only. missing for 10: confirmed integrations with Claude/Gemini/Copilot, general availability status beyond preview, broader geographic coverage.
